recipes.title: Walk with the arrow keys and animate
q: make him walk and animate with the arrow keys
walking animashun when i press right
move and change costume at the same time
steps: Green flag: the sprite only turns left and right, and keeps checking forever.
Right arrow: face right, move 5 steps, show the next costume.
Left arrow: the same, facing left. More costumes = a smoother walk (try Costumes → Animation).

recipes.title: Jump with gravity (platformer)
q: my sprite should fall down and jump
steps: A variable “y speed” pulls the sprite down a bit more every frame (gravity).
Below y = -120 is the floor: the sprite stops there.
Space on the floor = jump: y speed becomes 12.

recipes.title: Countdown timer
q: how do i make a timer that counts down
steps: Set “time left” to 30 and show it.
Every second, take 1 away.
At 0 the sprite says “Time's up!” and everything stops.

recipes.title: Falling rain (clones)
q: how do clones work for rain
steps: The sprite hides and makes a clone every 0.2 seconds.
Each clone starts at a random x at the top and falls.
At the bottom the clone deletes itself.

recipes.title: Quiz question with a score
q: ask a question and check the answer
steps: Ask a question and wait for the answer.
If the answer is right: +1 score and “Correct!”.
If not: “Not quite!”.

recipes.title: Two-sprite conversation (broadcast)
q: make two sprites talk to each other
steps: This sprite says hello, then sends the message “your turn”.
Put the second script on the OTHER sprite: when it receives “your turn”, it answers.
Broadcasts are how sprites tell each other what to do.
script: (Copy this script to the other sprite)

recipes.title: Clicker game
q: count how many times i click
steps: Set clicks to 0 and show it.
Every click adds 1 and the sprite pops bigger for a moment.

recipes.title: Enemy walks back and forth
q: enemy that walks left and right
steps: Face right and only turn left/right.
Move forever and bounce at the edge.

tips.title: Make an animation glide
q: how do i make my animation smooth
what does the glide button do
character pops instead of moving smooth
tips.text: Costumes → Animation. Make frame 1 (where it starts) and frame 2 (where it goes), then press Glide: the bones slide smoothly between them. Press Glide again to go back to your key frames.

tips.title: Turn a sprite into a tile map
q: how do i make a tile map
tips.text: The Tiles tab works on an empty sprite (no costumes). Open Costumes → Tiles → “Turn this sprite into a tile map”. You can turn it back as long as it has no costumes.

tips.title: Why are my costumes in a folder?
q: my costumes went into a folder
tips.text: Animation costumes are named like “walk//frame 1”. The part before // is the folder. Click the folder in the costume list to open or close it.

tips.title: forever vs repeat
q: what is the difference between forever and repeat
tips.text: “repeat (10)” runs the blocks inside 10 times, then goes on to the next block. “forever” never stops until you press Stop - nothing under it runs.

tips.title: broadcast vs broadcast and wait
tips.text: “broadcast” sends a message and keeps going. “broadcast and wait” waits until every “when I receive” script for that message has finished.

tips.title: My sprite doesn't move
q: nothing happens when i press start
tips.text: Check the top of your script: it needs a hat block like “when green flag clicked”. Then press Start. Use “Check my project” in GWrap AI to find loose blocks.

tips.title: Too many clones
q: how many clones can i make
tips.text: Like Scratch, a project can have 300 clones at a time. Delete clones you don't need (for example when they reach the edge) with “delete this clone”.

tips.title: Song maker styles
q: all my songs sound the same
tips.text: Sounds → Song maker. Pick a style (Lo-Fi, Synthwave, Upbeat Pop, Dark Arcade, Ambient, Electro House, Neo Jazz, Chiptune, Rock, Trap, Cinematic) and a mood, press Generate. Each style has its own melody.
